# Block 1: Essential Imports and Constants
from pyspark.sql.functions import explode, col, lit, from_json, size, when, coalesce, to_timestamp
from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, LongType, DoubleType, BooleanType, ArrayType, TimestampType
import os
import time
import traceback
from notebookutils import mssparkutils

# Directory paths - UPDATE THESE FOR YOUR PRODUCT ENVIRONMENT
STAGING_DIRECTORY = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/stagingMICE/products"
OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/outputMICE/products"
TEMP_DIRECTORY = "abfss://synapse@dudodatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/outputMICE/temp"

print("✓ Block 1 completed: Essential imports and constants")

# Block 2: Product Schemas
# VAT rates schema (nested within products)
vat_rates_schema = ArrayType(StructType([
    StructField("rate", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("vat", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("price", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("price_excl", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("general_ledger_number", StringType(), True)
]))

# Category schema (nested within products)
category_schema = StructType([
    StructField("id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("name", StringType(), True)
])

# Complete Product Schema (based on your JSON structure)
complete_product_schema = StructType([
    StructField("id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("amount_pp", LongType(), True),
    StructField("name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("description", StringType(), True),
    StructField("content", StringType(), True),
    StructField("price", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("price_excl_vat", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("vat", DoubleType(), True),
    StructField("general_ledger_number", StringType(), True),
    StructField("vat_rates", vat_rates_schema, True),
    StructField("code", StringType(), True),
    StructField("price_name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("group_id", LongType(), True),
    StructField("category", category_schema, True)
])

print("✓ Block 2 completed: Product schemas defined")

# Block 3: Data Reading
def read_staging_data():
    """Read all JSON product files and extract ALL products"""
    try:
        print(f"📂 Reading from: {STAGING_DIRECTORY}")
        
        files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(STAGING_DIRECTORY)
        json_files = [f.path for f in files if f.name.lower().endswith('.json')]
        
        print(f"🔍 Found {len(json_files)} JSON files")
        
        all_dataframes = []
        total_products = 0
        
        for file_path in json_files:
            text_df = spark.read.text(file_path)
            rows = text_df.collect()
            
            if rows:
                import json
                products_list = []
                
                for row in rows:
                    line = row[0].strip() if row[0] else ""
                    if line:
                        try:
                            # Handle both array format and single object format
                            if line.startswith('['):
                                # Array of products
                                product_array = json.loads(line)
                                products_list.extend(product_array)
                            else:
                                # Single product object
                                product_data = json.loads(line)
                                products_list.append(product_data)
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"⚠️ Error parsing line in {file_path}: {e}")
                            continue
                
                if products_list:
                    product_records = []
                    for i, product in enumerate(products_list):
                        product_records.append({
                            "json_data_string": json.dumps(product),
                            "source_file_name": file_path,
                            "product_index": i
                        })
                    
                    products_df = spark.createDataFrame(product_records)
                    all_dataframes.append(products_df)
                    total_products += len(products_list)
                    print(f"✅ {os.path.basename(file_path)}: {len(products_list)} products")
        
        if not all_dataframes:
            print("❌ No product data found!")
            return None
            
        print(f"📊 TOTAL PRODUCTS FOUND: {total_products}")
        
        # Union all DataFrames
        final_df = all_dataframes[0]
        for df in all_dataframes[1:]:
            final_df = final_df.union(df)
        
        # Parse back to structured format
        structured_df = final_df.select(
            from_json(col("json_data_string"), complete_product_schema).alias("parsed_product"),
            col("source_file_name").alias("source_file"),
            col("product_index")
        ).select("parsed_product.*", "source_file", "product_index")
        
        return structured_df.cache()
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error reading data: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        raise

print("✓ Block 3 completed: Data reading")

# Block 4: Product Data Extraction
def extract_product_vat_rates(df):
    """Extract VAT rates from products - FLATTENED FOR DATA FLOW"""
    print("🔍 Extracting product VAT rates...")
    
    products_with_vat = df.filter(col("vat_rates").isNotNull() & (size(col("vat_rates")) > 0))
    
    if products_with_vat.count() == 0:
        print("ℹ️ No product VAT rates found")
        return None
    
    product_vat_rates = products_with_vat.select(
        col("id").alias("product_id"),
        col("name").alias("product_name"),
        col("group_id").alias("product_group_id"),
        col("category.id").alias("category_id"),
        col("category.name").alias("category_name"),
        explode(col("vat_rates")).alias("vat_rate"),
        col("source_file")
    ).select(
        col("product_id"),
        col("product_name"),
        col("product_group_id"),
        col("category_id"),
        col("category_name"),
        col("vat_rate.rate").alias("vat_rate"),
        col("vat_rate.vat").alias("vat_amount"),
        col("vat_rate.price").alias("vat_price"),
        col("vat_rate.price_excl").alias("vat_price_excl"),
        col("vat_rate.general_ledger_number").alias("vat_general_ledger_number"),
        col("source_file")
    )
    
    print(f"✅ Product VAT rates: {product_vat_rates.count():,}")
    return product_vat_rates

def extract_product_categories(df):
    """Extract unique product categories"""
    print("🔍 Extracting product categories...")
    
    products_with_categories = df.filter(col("category").isNotNull())
    
    if products_with_categories.count() == 0:
        print("ℹ️ No product categories found")
        return None
    
    product_categories = products_with_categories.select(
        col("category.id").alias("category_id"),
        col("category.name").alias("category_name"),
        col("source_file")
    ).dropDuplicates(["category_id"])
    
    print(f"✅ Product categories: {product_categories.count():,}")
    return product_categories

def parse_and_extract_all(df):
    """Extract all product data"""
    print("🔍 Extracting product data...")
    
    # Extract VAT rates
    vat_rates_df = extract_product_vat_rates(df)
    
    # Extract categories
    categories_df = extract_product_categories(df)
    
    return vat_rates_df, categories_df

print("✓ Block 4 completed: Product data extraction")

# Block 5: FIXED Parquet File Writing - WITH TEMP DIRECTORY
def ensure_directory_exists(dir_path):
    """Create directory if needed"""
    try:
        if not mssparkutils.fs.exists(dir_path):
            mssparkutils.fs.mkdirs(dir_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Directory warning: {e}")

def clean_temp_directory(temp_dir_path):
    """Clean temp directory"""
    try:
        if mssparkutils.fs.exists(temp_dir_path) and TEMP_DIRECTORY in temp_dir_path:
            mssparkutils.fs.rm(temp_dir_path, True)
            print(f"   Cleaned temp: {temp_dir_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Cleanup warning: {e}")

def write_single_parquet_file(df, table_name):
    """Write single Parquet file using EXACT working pattern"""
    temp_output = f"{TEMP_DIRECTORY}/{table_name}"
    final_output = f"{OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/{table_name}.parquet"
    
    print(f"🔍 Writing {table_name} as single Parquet file...")
    print(f"   Records: {df.count()}")
    
    try:
        start_time = time.time()
        
        # Ensure directories exist
        ensure_directory_exists(TEMP_DIRECTORY)
        
        # Check if final output exists and delete
        if mssparkutils.fs.exists(final_output):
            mssparkutils.fs.rm(final_output, False)
            print(f"   Removed existing output file: {final_output}")
        
        # Clean temp directory before writing
        clean_temp_directory(temp_output)
        
        # Write to temporary location
        df.coalesce(1).write.mode("overwrite").option("compression", "snappy").parquet(temp_output)
        
        # Find the part file
        part_files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(temp_output)
        parquet_part_file = next((f for f in part_files if f.name.startswith("part-") and f.name.endswith(".parquet")), None)
        
        if parquet_part_file:
            # Move the file to final location
            source_path = f"{temp_output}/{parquet_part_file.name}"
            mssparkutils.fs.mv(source_path, final_output, True, True)
            print(f"✓ Moved processed file to final output: {final_output}")
            
            # Clean up temp directory
            clean_temp_directory(temp_output)
            
            # Report success
            end_time = time.time()
            print(f"✓ Successfully processed file: {table_name} in {end_time - start_time:.2f} seconds")
            
            # Verify the file
            try:
                verify_df = spark.read.parquet(final_output)
                print(f"✅ Verified: {table_name}.parquet with {verify_df.count()} rows")
                return True
            except Exception as verify_error:
                print(f"❌ Verification failed: {verify_error}")
                return False
        else:
            print(f"⚠️ Error: No part file found in {temp_output}")
            return False
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error processing file {table_name}: {str(e)}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False
        
    finally:
        # Always clean up temp directory
        clean_temp_directory(temp_output)

def write_all_tables(df, vat_rates_df, categories_df):
    """Write all tables as single Parquet files using temp approach"""
    print("💾 Writing all tables as single Parquet files...")
    
    try:
        # Create main products table
        products_df = df.select(
            col("id").alias("product_id"),
            col("amount_pp"),
            col("name").alias("product_name"),
            col("description").alias("product_description"),
            col("content").alias("product_content"),
            col("price"),
            col("price_excl_vat"),
            col("vat"),
            col("general_ledger_number"),
            col("code").alias("product_code"),
            col("price_name"),
            col("group_id"),
            col("category.id").alias("category_id"),
            col("category.name").alias("category_name"),
            col("source_file")
        ).dropDuplicates(["product_id"])
        
        # Write all tables using temp approach
        success1 = write_single_parquet_file(products_df, "dudok_products")
        
        success2 = True
        if vat_rates_df is not None and vat_rates_df.count() > 0:
            success2 = write_single_parquet_file(vat_rates_df, "dudok_product_vat_rates")
        else:
            print("ℹ️ No product VAT rates to write")
        
        success3 = True
        if categories_df is not None and categories_df.count() > 0:
            success3 = write_single_parquet_file(categories_df, "dudok_product_categories")
        else:
            print("ℹ️ No product categories to write")
        
        return all([success1, success2, success3])
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error in write_all_tables: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False

print("✓ Block 5 completed: Single Parquet file writing with temp directory")

# Block 6: Main Pipeline
def run_complete_pipeline():
    """Complete pipeline execution"""
    print("🚀 Starting complete product pipeline...")
    start_time = time.time()
    
    try:
        # Read all products
        print("📂 Step 1: Reading JSON products...")
        df = read_staging_data()
        
        if df is None:
            print("❌ No data to process")
            return False
        
        # Extract VAT rates and categories
        print("🔍 Step 2: Extracting VAT rates and categories...")
        vat_rates_df, categories_df = parse_and_extract_all(df)
        
        # Write all tables
        print("💾 Step 3: Writing all tables...")
        success = write_all_tables(df, vat_rates_df, categories_df)
        
        if success:
            products_count = df.count()
            vat_rates_count = vat_rates_df.count() if vat_rates_df else 0
            categories_count = categories_df.count() if categories_df else 0
            duration = time.time() - start_time
            
            print(f"\n✅ PIPELINE COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!")
            print(f"📊 Products: {products_count:,}")
            print(f"📊 VAT Rates: {vat_rates_count:,}")
            print(f"📊 Categories: {categories_count:,}")
            print(f"⏱️ Duration: {duration:.2f} seconds")
            print(f"📁 Output directory: {OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/")
            
            return True
        else:
            print("❌ Pipeline failed")
            return False
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Pipeline error: {e}")
        traceback.print_exc()
        return False

# Verification function
def verify_parquet_outputs():
    """Verify all Parquet files are readable and properly formatted"""
    print("\n🔍 VERIFYING PARQUET OUTPUTS...")
    
    tables = ["dudok_products", "dudok_product_vat_rates", "dudok_product_categories"]
    
    for table in tables:
        file_path = f"{OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/{table}.parquet"
        try:
            if mssparkutils.fs.exists(file_path):
                # Read as Parquet
                df = spark.read.parquet(file_path)
                print(f"✅ {table}: {df.count()} rows, {len(df.columns)} columns")
                
                # Show schema
                print(f"   Schema: {df.columns}")
                
                # Show sample data
                if df.count() > 0:
                    print(f"   Sample data:")
                    df.show(2, truncate=True)
                
            else:
                print(f"❌ {table}: File not found")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ {table}: Error reading - {e}")

print("✓ Complete pipeline ready")
print("\n🎯 To execute:")
print("1. Run: success = run_complete_pipeline()")
print("2. Verify: verify_parquet_outputs()")

# AUTO-EXECUTE
print("\n🚀 AUTO-EXECUTING PIPELINE...")
success = run_complete_pipeline()

if success:
    print("\n🔍 VERIFYING OUTPUTS...")
    verify_parquet_outputs()

print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"FINAL RESULT: {'SUCCESS' if success else 'FAILED'}")
print(f"{'='*50}")
